links.name: California official 2026 results guidance
links.scope_note: Official November 3 voter guide identifies the public results portal and post-close reporting plan; guide is not itself a live race feed. Public results portal currently redirects to prior elections.

links.name: New Jersey official county-results directory
links.scope_note: NJ explicitly posts neither official nor unofficial Election Night results statewide; use the listed county sites. County results are partial, not an independently reconciled NJ-07 district total.

links.name: Texas official November 2026 results roster
links.scope_note: Nov 3 2026 page, updated Oct 14, has candidate rosters and 0 percent reporting with blank ballot fields. No counted votes or winner call verified; manual reference only.

links.name: Illinois State Board of Elections results directory
links.scope_note: Official election selector currently shows2026 GENERAL PRIMARY, not November general-election votes. Human reference only; no automated totals or calls.

links.name: New York official election reporting page
links.scope_note: General Election page observed with October23 source clock and zero governor returns; not a verified NY26 live result or automated feed. County recanvass/corrections remain required.

links.name: Oregon official general-election guidance
links.scope_note: Official November3 upcoming-election guidance; this is not a live results feed, counted votes or a professional call.

links.name: Tennessee official historical results
links.scope_note: Historical results page currently lists August2026/older elections, not November2026 live returns. Timing of future publication is unverified.

links.name: Wisconsin official results guidance
links.scope_note: WEC states there is no central statewide unofficial Election Night feed; county clerks publish results. This guidance and official historical reports are not a live race feed.

limitations: Links are human-check references, not verified live feeds, reported votes, or professional race calls. Massachusetts expressly does not publish unofficial statewide election-night results. Mississippi's Secretary of State stated in its 2024 election-day guidance that its office only announces and posts certified results; do not rely on that office as an unofficial live feed without a newly verified 2026 source. Alabama's current unofficial election-night results landing page does not yet show a 2026 general-election result, and the DDHQ AL-07 results view had 0 votes before Nov 3. A browser page is not an automated source.

public_editorial_calls.information: Directly reviewed Nov 3 2026 U.S. House/Senate race pages for identity gaps and operational recovery, accessible for manual viewing. Pre-election pages show FORECASTS and zero placeholders, not counted ballots or calls. Verify an explicit race call, named winner, date and office. Never scrape, infer votes or feed these links into automatic 506-race coverage.
